description: Everything about one German military rank (Dienstgrad): service, abbreviation, rank group, level 1-26, NATO code, pay grade and 2026 base pay, form of address, insignia, the equivalent ranks in the other services, how one gets the rank under the Soldatenlaufbahnverordnung, typical posts where bundeswehr.de states them, and the US/UK ranks with the same NATO code. Text fields are in German.

rank.description: A Bundeswehr rank name or abbreviation in German, any service, e.g. "Hauptmann", "KKpt", "Oberstabsarzt", "Flieger".

name: find_rank
title: Look up a Bundeswehr rank
